title.text: Regional Copies of the Autonomy Petition

offer.text: Bring four sheets for copies of a civilian autonomy petition. Payment: four emeralds. Completion may support a later proposal; it does not change sovereignty or diplomacy. This commission answers one recorded regional opportunity or signed voluntary obligation.

accept.text: The petition service terms and control snapshot are now fixed.

decline.text: No political position is inferred from declining.

in_progress.text: Bring four sheets to the original issuer.

ready.text: The petition copies are ready to receive.

complete.text: The copying service is recorded. Sovereignty and native relations are unchanged. Four emeralds are paid.
